reasoning: This repo is a collection of eval-hub plugin adapters, packaged as batch-job container images. It does not fit the operator, library, service, or configuration categories. Each directory under adapters/ (lighteval, inspect, guidellm, mteb, ragas, deepeval, promptfoo, ifbench, etc.) wraps an external evaluation framework. It does this by subclassing FrameworkAdapter from the evalhub-sdk and implementing run_benchmark_job(). Each adapter ships a Containerfile and a provider.yaml. The provider.yaml registers the adapter with the eval-hub service and declares its Kubernetes runtime: image, `python main.py` entrypoint, and resources. The eval-hub service starts these images as short-lived Kubernetes jobs. Each job runs one benchmark, reports its progress back through callbacks, and can persist results to MLflow or as OCI artifacts. It is not an operator: there are no CRDs or controllers. It is not a long-running service: no API server. It is not a library: adapters ship as runnable container images, not importable packages. It is not pure configuration, although provider.yaml files and collections/*.yaml are part of it. The best label is 'evaluation framework adapters / workload images for the eval-hub service'. Tekton/Konflux pipelines build the RHOAI images for the lighteval and inspect adapters.
